subject: OSM way 92379286 on the south side of Södra Långgatan: the cream house next to the palace and the stone corner house on Kaggensgatan with the 1659 portal, with their rear ranges.
author: Claude (Anthropic), 2026-09-24
fixed_during_the_pass: the gate and the portal door as rectangular holes with closed spandrel prisms (arched holes left slivers at the crowns)
the palace's and 92379292's party walls filled above the new, lower roofs (they were built against the old district height 9.75 m)
the copper roof behind the gable closed with cheeks
the gate 2.32 m wide with its inner crown at 3.08 and its leaves nearly flush
the gable moved to s 3.82, 0.08 m behind the facade (it stood about 9 px off in the oblique view)
the portal's piers 0.60 m wide instead of 0.72, the door without a light casing
the corner house's gutter 0.45 m out instead of 0.57
